prereg.decision: Should TensorDEM's LBM-DEM closure calibration apply the periodic-box (finite-size) drag enhancement BEFORE the flow controller / settling drive is set, instead of only as a post-hoc division of the measured force?  Answer decides whether `SettlingSpec.finite_size_in_drive` becomes the default path and whether the post-hoc multiplication must be switched off together with it.

alternatives.M0_posthoc_only: drive/seed from the unbounded Stokes force; array correction applied only to the reported number (current code path: finite_size_in_drive=False, apply_array_correction_posthoc=True)
alternatives.M1_drive_and_posthoc: correction folded into the drive AND kept in the post-processing (double counting, lambda^2)
alternatives.M2_drive_only: correction folded into the drive, no post-hoc multiplication (the 'finite-size-before-controller' practice)

hypothesis: H1 (operating point): M0's achieved Re at L/d=4 is biased low by (1/lambda - 1) = -43.7% because the drive is built for unbounded Stokes drag while the periodic array has lambda = 1.7754 > 1. M2 removes that bias to within the IBM/SN residual.
H2 (double counting): M1's reported corrected velocity is high by (lambda - 1) = +77.5% at L/d=4, i.e. applying the correction in both places is worse than not applying it at all.

H3 (fixed-sphere seed): for the constant-flow-rate pump the converged ratio is seed independent; correction_timing affects only the transient (steps to within 2% of the final force), by a factor to be measured at L/d=4, gain in {0.005, 0.02}.

H4 (formula validity): the dilute Hasimoto/Sangani-Acrivos ratio lambda(phi)=1+1.7601 phi^(1/3)+phi reproduces the measured array ratio to <15% for phi <= 0.0654 at fixed resolution; the residual is dominated by the IBM resolution error, not by the phi term.

metrics.xval_error: |measured ratio / analytic ratio - 1| per phi for the fixed-sphere array drag
metrics.reported_bias: u_rel_error_sn_corrected (settling, reported corrected velocity vs Schiller-Naumann at the measured Re)

prereg.stopping_rule: Run the pre-declared case list once; no case is added after inspecting results. If a case does not reach steady state within its step budget the outcome is reported as a budget-limited FAIL, not re-run with a larger budget.

changed: sphere diameter d in {4,6,8} at fixed L/d=8
confounders: IBM/MEM discretisation error grows as d shrinks (independent of phi at fixed d) - handled by the fixed-resolution phi scan and by the d-scan at fixed L/d
Schiller-Naumann is itself only ~1-2% accurate at Re~1
float32 round-off limits force-drift convergence to ~1e-4

environment.host: m17417 worktree, CPU torch, torch threads pinned per worker
environment.note: cluster queue depth 517 at submission time -> sweep kept to <=6 min per single case and run in parallel workers; every run's wall time is recorded
